title: Equal-degree component energies under symmetry
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $(\psi_a)_{a\in\iota}$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function and is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. For any $n\in\mathbb N$, suppose $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$ is invariant under every permutation of its $n$ coordinates. If $S,T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ have the same cardinality, then the Fourier components of $f$ supported on $S$ and $T$ have equal squared norms in the product measure $\pi^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
